question: Can one scale-aware adjacent-frame proposal link occupy the unused third set slot and recover the first sparse-query miss without displacing either preserved contributor?

temporal_link.selection: Link proposal boxes only when adjacent-frame IoU is strictly greater than 0.5. Select the link maximizing mean semantic/local fused score minus 0.05 times mean nearest-reference log-area distance; ties use higher link IoU, higher unpenalized mean fused score, then earlier frozen candidate order.
temporal_link.vacancy_contract: Remove only the failed axis-completion vacancy row from the predecessor set. Preserve every original contributor. Add each side of the selected temporal link only when it is not already present; otherwise fall back to the predecessor axis row. Keep at most three hypotheses per query.
temporal_link.truth_boundary: Frames, reference scales, proposal boxes and frozen candidate scores determine the link. Query target boxes and IoU enter only after the bounded set is complete.

literature_motivation.use: Associates adjacent-frame boxes when IoU exceeds 0.5 and maximizes a sequence detection score to repair single-frame ranking errors. The reference-scale term is this Development branch's bounded addition.

literature_motivation.source: Leveraging Long-Range Temporal Relationships Between Proposals for Video Object Detection
literature_motivation.use: Supports proposal-level temporal relationships as a light-weight source of context; mechanism motivation only.

forbidden_after_freeze: change frame pair, link IoU, 0.05 scale penalty, link score, deterministic ties, preserved contributors, vacancy-only rule, fallback, IoU gate or set-size bound
use truth to select the temporal pair, add more than one new candidate per query, retry or rescue
claim fresh confirmation from this consumed posthoc Development
claim_boundary: This family and its RGB/model roster were consumed before the temporal-scale vacancy branch was defined. A pass is Development evidence that an adjacent-frame proposal link can carry a correct candidate inside a bounded set; it is not fresh confirmation, top-one localization, calibrated uncertainty, open-set rejection, raw-phone operation, referent binding, named entrance, ownership, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, benefit, reliability or safety.
